concept.hr: O prelasku odlučuje klijent, a ne AP; ljepljivi klijenti
concept.en: The client, not the AP, decides when to roam; sticky clients

summary.hr: Prošetaj klijenta hodnikom s tri access pointa: sam bira kada prelazi, pa se ljepljivi klijent drži dalekog AP-a, a AP ga može samo zamoliti da ode.
summary.en: Walk a client down a corridor past three access points: it alone decides when to roam, so a sticky client clings to a far AP, and the AP can only ask.
